reason: A deterministic finance data toolkit for formatting, financial calculations, projections, portfolio analysis, and data-quality checks; the README states it has no filesystem access and is side-effect free.

summaries.zh: 为智能体提供金融数字格式化、收益与估值计算、风险分析、规划及投资组合数据处理工具。
summaries.en: Provides agents with tools for financial number formatting, return and valuation calculations, risk analysis, planning, and portfolio data processing.

capabilities: Formats financial numbers, currencies, percentages, and Chinese units
Calculates returns, valuation ratios, time value, and risk metrics
Generates data-quality checklists and financial projections
Calculates portfolio weights, target drift, and rebalance orders without executing trades
